Downstream for every pass (measured on B0002): post without approval -> policy.unapproved_post; self-approval -> policy.segregation_of_duties; wrong role -> policy.segregation_of_duties. Memo text never changes amount, invoice or approval state, so a pass cannot post a number by itself.

## Memo rule: what was applied and what remains a limit

- Two tiers (core/rules_memo.py, core/rules_memo_flag.py): HARD refuses only markup, role prefixes, override phrases aimed at the checker and encoded/obfuscated text; SOFT flags finance words (approve, partial payment, discount, credit note, authorised...) and the approver must tick an acknowledgement (policy.memo_unacknowledged) to approve.
- This attack set was used to tune the rule, so its block rate is coverage of this list, not generalisation. The blind held-out sets in bench/heldout are the honest numbers; 'passed unflagged' is the figure that matters.
- Limit: paraphrases outside the phrase list pass or are only flagged. The numeric rules, SoD and human approval stop posting regardless of memo text; the memo rule is a tripwire plus a flag, not the control.
